readings: For telescopes whose bandwidth usage (`bandusagepct`) is strictly greater than 47.6, give for each calibration status (`calibrstatus`) the average bandwidth usage and the number of telescopes.

For telescopes whose bandwidth usage (`bandusagepct`) is greater than or equal to 47.6 (so a telescope at exactly 47.6 counts as high), give for each calibration status (`calibrstatus`) the average bandwidth usage and the number of telescopes.
queries:
SELECT calibrstatus, AVG(bandusagepct) AS avg_bandusagepct, COUNT(*) AS telescope_count
FROM telescopes
WHERE bandusagepct > 47.6
GROUP BY calibrstatus;
SELECT calibrstatus, AVG(bandusagepct) AS avg_bandwidth_usage, COUNT(*) AS telescope_count
FROM telescopes
WHERE bandusagepct >= 47.6
GROUP BY calibrstatus;
